recreation_brief: 1. Create a blank slide; set the slide background to light gray (#E9E9E7). Optionally place this on a white canvas/margin to mimic the video frame. 2. Draw a rectangle covering the slide area with no fill and a ~1.5pt dark-red (#8B1A1A) outline to create the border frame. 3. Insert a centered text box at roughly 30-42% of slide height containing 'Review of ' at ~54pt bold and 'Part I' at ~40pt bold, both in royal blue (#1C1CC8), Arial, on one line. 4. Insert a second centered text box at roughly 50-60% of slide height containing 'Self Attention Mechanism' at ~40pt bold, same royal blue (#1C1CC8). 5. In the top-right corner (~90% horizontal, ~13% vertical), draw a small oval (~1.0 x 0.7 cm), fill pale yellow (#FFFF80), outline purple (#9933CC) at ~1.5pt, and add the text '3' in dark gray (#333333), ~12pt, centered. 6. Add a solid black (#000000) rectangle strip across the very bottom edge of the slide (full width, ~3-4% of slide height) to reproduce the footer bar. 7. Leave the lower half of the slide empty; do not add the mouse cursor (it is a recording artifact). 8. No other text, charts, or images are present.
